editorNote: Three rooms London's feed is pushing this week — a rooftop for the view, a Fitzrovia set-menu steal, and a Soho tapas stalwart — each checked against its ratings before it made the cut.

stories.headline: Solaya: sunset dining 25 floors above Shoreditch
stories.summary: Kenny Atkinson's first London room sits on the top floor of Art'otel Hoxton, pairing a full-floor skyline view with a French-Mediterranean menu — and a £55 'Taste of Solaya' set that undercuts the city's other view restaurants.
stories.context: Chef Kenny Atkinson's first London opening; it takes the whole 25th floor, so the sunset view runs a full 360°.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the week's most-shared date-night pick — a view room people rate for the food, not just the skyline.

reviews.text: Solaya delivered sunshine on a plate, even when there was none to be seen in the skies.
reviews.author: DesignMyNight

sourceLinks.title: Xiaohongshu — 半枚金币：Solaya 日落约会餐厅

stories.headline: Clipstone's £20.16 set menu is the week's best Michelin-adjacent steal
stories.summary: Portland's low-key Fitzrovia sibling still runs a three-course set at £20.16 — a nod to its 2016 opening — changing monthly and served only in the 5:30–6pm slot. Book ahead.
stories.context: The relaxed Fitzrovia sibling of Michelin-starred Portland; the set menu is redrawn every month.
stories.whyItMatters: A rare way into serious cooking for the price of a pub main — if you can grab the early slot.

reviews.text: A meal here is never going to be cheap, but the food's never showy
reviews.author: The Infatuation

stories.headline: Copita: the Soho tapas counter regulars keep going back to
stories.summary: A D'Arblay Street standby doing tight, well-made Spanish plates — acorn-fed Ibérico presa, a tender grilled octopus leg, a Basque cheesecake worth ordering — at around £50 a head.
stories.whyItMatters: Proof the reliable neighbourhood tapas bar still beats the hyped new opening most weeks.

reviews.text: This place has a massive range of well made tapas, it's all quite reasonably priced
reviews.author: The Infatuation

sourceLinks.title: Xiaohongshu — Ich bin Taro：伦敦西班牙菜天花板 Copita
